t2.thesis: LRCX enters earnings after a sharp semis selloff with a strong beat-and-raise track record, but the 7.6% implied move already prices much of the good news, so the edge over the base rate is small.
reasons: Semis cluster base rate is weak (47.9%), but the AMC and overall rates are about 54%, so the prior sits near 51%
Stock is down 12% over 5 days and 1 month, with a record chip-ETF losing streak and heavy hedge fund de-risking, which sets up a low bar and possible relief
Last 4 prints: 3 of 4 up, with 8%, 7.9%, 8.7% EPS beats; the last guide of $8.1B was well above prior levels, and estimates were revised up 19% over 90 days
Implied move of 7.6% and IV at 1.37x realized vol means expectations are elevated; AI capex worry could cap the reaction
Call/put IV is balanced (spread -0.2%), so options give no directional signal
t2.deciding_variable: Next-quarter revenue guide versus the high consensus (about $8.1B+ for Sep, and the December quarter outlook), plus the tone on AI capex sustainability and China exposure.

prior.from: Semis cluster base rate 47.9% (n=434), blended with AMC 53.8% and overall 54.2%; roughly 0.51

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. I have no reliable information about how LRCX's stock moved after its 2026-10-21 earnings report, since that is at or beyond what I know from memory.
t2.moved_from_prior: Up about 2 points, from 0.51 to 0.53, on oversold positioning and the consistent beat history, partly offset by the high bar from the estimate revisions and the weak semis cluster base rate.

theses.expected: Beat and raise with a guide above consensus, and the stock gaps up at the open
theses.mechanism: Washed-out positioning and strong foundry and AI demand produce a relief rally in the group
theses.wrong_if: The guide only matches consensus or the stock fades given the elevated estimates

theses.expected: Beat but sell-off at the open
theses.mechanism: Elevated expectations after upward revisions and AI spending worries make good news insufficient, as with ASML dropping on a record quarter
theses.wrong_if: The guide significantly exceeds consensus and peers rally

theses.expected: Muted move within plus or minus 3%
theses.mechanism: Options already price the event and results are in line with high expectations
theses.wrong_if: A surprise in China restrictions or the capex outlook drives a large move either way

key_observations: December-quarter revenue and EPS guide versus consensus
Gross margin trajectory versus the 52% guide
China revenue share and export control commentary
Foundry/memory mix and WFE outlook for 2027
Deferred revenue and customer commentary on AI capex sustainability
